summary: Authored a 7-phase plan fixing the Path 1 MAX_ARG_STRLEN accumulator, the wrong csljson end-of-pagination signal, the no-op itemType filter, and adding a content-keyed shrink guard with an --allow-shrink opt-out distinct from --force, plus offline curl-stub regression coverage and four doc updates.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase implementation plan, 9 hours estimated, fully serialized for phases 2-5 (same-file edits).

user_decision.question: Research found that fetch_path3's sqlite filter excludes the wrong itemTypeIDs, so the existing on-disk 4049-item export is ~61% attachment/note/annotation stubs. Should this task also correct that filter (Phase 5), which drops those stub entries from future sqlite-path exports and lowers the shrink guard's baseline to a true bibliographic count?
options: Fix it in this task (Phase 5) -- the shrink guard then protects a real bibliographic baseline, and the first post-fix regeneration legitimately needs --allow-shrink once
Leave it and spin it out as a follow-up task -- smaller blast radius, but the shrink guard ships with a knowingly contaminated raw-item-table baseline
user_decision.recommended: Fix it in this task (Phase 5) -- the shrink guard then protects a real bibliographic baseline, and the first post-fix regeneration legitimately needs --allow-shrink once
